findings.summary: The 'more' bottom sheet omits showDragHandle: true while the sibling _showProfile sheet (line 408) enables it, so the two modal sheets look inconsistent.
findings.fix: Add showDragHandle: true to the showModalBottomSheet call at line 310 to match _showProfile, and remove the manual top padding of 0 so the drag handle spacing is consistent.

findings.summary: The 'more' grid tile label uses a bare const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900) with no color from the color scheme, unlike the rest of the file which reads colors from Theme.
findings.fix: Use Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelLarge?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900) or set color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface so the label follows theme/dark-mode colors.

findings.summary: The 'more' grid tiles use a bespoke Ink/BoxDecoration card with borderRadius 18, diverging from the design-system card radius of 20.
findings.fix: Use borderRadius 20 (matching the app_theme card radius token) for both the InkWell (line 338) and the Ink decoration (line 351) so the tiles align with the design-system card radius.

findings.summary: The notifications provider's loading and error states are silently coerced to an unread count of 0, so a failed fetch is indistinguishable from having zero unread items.
findings.fix: Acceptable for a passive badge, but consider distinguishing error state; silently mapping loading/error to 0 unread hides fetch failures.
